classes.name: ToastComponent
classes.description: Blazor component that displays toast notifications, handles their state, styling, and visibility, and responds to show/hide events.

methods.name: get_ToastService
methods.description: Getter for the injected ToastService instance.

methods.name: set_ToastService
methods.description: Setter for the injected ToastService instance.

methods.name: get_Heading
methods.description: Getter for the toast heading string.

methods.name: set_Heading
methods.description: Setter for the toast heading string.

methods.name: get_Message
methods.description: Getter for the toast message string.

methods.name: set_Message
methods.description: Setter for the toast message string.

methods.name: get_IsVisible
methods.description: Getter indicating whether the toast is visible.

methods.name: set_IsVisible
methods.description: Setter to show or hide the toast.

methods.name: get_BackgroundCssClass
methods.description: Getter for the CSS class used for the toast background.

methods.name: set_BackgroundCssClass
methods.description: Setter for the background CSS class.

methods.name: get_IconCssClass
methods.description: Getter for the CSS class for the toast icon.

methods.name: set_IconCssClass
methods.description: Setter for the icon CSS class.

methods.name: OnInitialized
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the component is initialized. Sets up event subscriptions for show/hide toast events.

methods.name: ShowToast
methods.description: Event handler to display the toast with specified message and level.

methods.name: HideToast
methods.description: Event handler to hide the toast.

methods.name: BuildToastSettings
methods.description: Configures CSS classes and heading based on the toast level.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Cleans up event subscriptions when the component is disposed.
